extra_quotes: We benchmark both routes and two hybrid schemes on amorphous Li 0.9NbO0.9Cl4.1 against one neutron pair distribution function with one foundation potential.
We ran the dynamics in LAMMPS [43] using the mliap pair style and the protocol in Table I, with a timestep of 2 fs and thermostat and barostat damping times of 0.1 ps.
The sample is not wholly amorphous. Internal-standard refinement shows that about 55% of this composition is amorphous, a fraction that is constant across a stoichiometry series [9].
Second, the neutron contrast is uneven. Chlorine supplies 79% of the mean coherent scattering length ⟨b⟩, whereas Li pairs carry only 6.3% of the neutron weight (Eq. (1)).
